regions.name: Sidebar
regions.describes: Brand-green navigation with groups, icons, compact mode and collapse toggle
regions.why: Already built: the Wisej NavigationBar extension (Wisej.Web.Ext.NavigationBar) the page has used all along; restyled in the mixin.

regions.name: Top bar
regions.describes: Breadcrumb, search, environment badge, alerts bell, user initials, data-as-of
regions.why: One 48px bar with breadcrumb, search, badge and bell together; the project's AppTopBar component already draws all of it, initials included.

regions.name: User menu
regions.describes: Name/role header, Theme submenu, Show demo notes toggle, Reset board

regions.name: Alerts popup
regions.describes: List of alerts with severity icons, click navigates

regions.name: Search results popup
regions.describes: Search hits or No results, click navigates

regions.name: Page header
regions.describes: Page title with a one-line subtitle, then the optional demo-notes row (intro, status, Reset button)

regions.name: Content host
regions.describes: Plain host panel that the selected page's own panel (which holds the project's GridBoard) is docked into, full width
regions.why: It is only a container; the board inside is the project's own GridBoard component, on the page panels.
